additional_info.subject: RE: ID0438856-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2/P0 312561850/16] The screen is black CRM:02889000246
additional_info.body:
Hello,
If your diagnostics confirm the need to replace the fuses, and this is not covered by the warranty, we can call in one of our maintenance technicians.
Is it possible to have the reference number of these fuses? If there are several and you can't tell me which ones are in this charger, can I have all the possible part references for these fuses (we may have several corresponding models in stock).
Also, what happens if we replace the fuses and the terminal doesn't restart ? We will have replaced out-of-warranty fuses, at our own expense, without solving the issue.
Other work is going to be carried out on the same charging station (ID0438859, ID0438867, ID0438865, ID0438871 and ID0438876). Do you think it would be possible to carry out an on-site check (of course, we will be billed for parts if necessary)?
Many thanks.
Best regards,
Nicolas RAYMOND
Ingénieur Exploitation IRVE
